# Code of Conduct

This is Al Ummah Now's fork of OpenAuth. Everyone who takes part here, in issues, pull requests or
reviews, agrees to the following.

## What we expect

- Be kind and respectful, and assume good intent.
- Discuss the work, not the person. When you disagree with a decision, explain the problem it causes
  and what you would do instead.
- Accept feedback, and own your mistakes.

## What we don't accept

- Insults, harassment, threats, or demeaning comments of any kind, including about faith, origin,
  language, sex, age, disability or level of experience.
- Sexual language or imagery.
- Publishing someone's private information without their permission.
- Wasting people's time on purpose: spam, trolling, or repeating a closed discussion.

## Reporting

- **A security problem:** never in public. Use private vulnerability reporting, as
  [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) describes.
- **Someone's behavior:** use the [contact form](https://videos.alummahnow.net/contact) and include a
  link to what happened. We keep reports private.

Maintainers may edit or remove contributions that break these rules, and block people who keep
breaking them.

Questions about the original project go to [OpenAuth](https://github.com/anomalyco/openauth). Please
don't report problems in this fork there.
